title: NFL Football
desc: The Detroit Lions clash with Chicago Bears in their first NFC meeting of the season. Detroit looks to protect a 6-0 home record behind four sacks in a 31-21 victory, while 8-2 Chicago relies on five straight wins to claim sole possession of first.

title: NFL Football
desc: The Cowboys host the Eagles in NFL regular-season play at AT&T Stadium. Dallas, at 5-6, beat Philadelphia 38-21 just a month ago, and the Eagles arrive at 3-7 after snapping a seven-game losing streak with a 19-16 win over the Steelers last week.

title: NFL Football
desc: The Bills host the Chiefs in NFL regular-season play at Highmark Stadium. First in the AFC at 9-1, Buffalo have won nine of their last ten; Kansas City arrives at 8-2 but have dropped two of their last five.

title: Live: Good Morning Football
